source_byte_probe.interpretation: External repository anti-bot/access behavior blocked byte acquisition from GitHub Actions. This is an infrastructure access result, not evidence that the source datasets are unavailable to users through their public records.
source_byte_probe.dryad_pattern: public landing pages resolve file identities, while API/file_stream routes returned authorization/challenge responses in the runner
source_byte_probe.zenodo_pattern: record metadata and public file identities are externally verifiable, while direct file downloads returned 403 in the runner for the tested static routes

forced_invalid_variance_diagnostic.assumption_warning: At least two diagnostic SEs require invalid/unverified zero-covariance and uncertainty-label assumptions. These statistics are stress-test diagnostics and not inferential meta-analysis estimates.

additional_mechanistic_evidence.de_manincor_2023: +4 C experiment advanced plant flowering (community peak 7.4 d earlier) but did not detectably change Osmia lignaria emergence; retained as mechanistic anchor because temperature treatment is confounded with greenhouse room and endpoints use different inferential scales
additional_mechanistic_evidence.olliff_yang_mesler_2018: plant and bee timing both temperature-responsive but cue/model structure differs; not pooled until identical exposure metric is reconstructable
additional_mechanistic_evidence.iler_2013: flower and syrphid responses differ to snowmelt/GDD; not convertible to days/C without a new raw-data reconstruction

decision.ecological_conclusion_for_screen: Local information access does not imply a universal plant-versus-pollinator response ordering; the limited commensurable systems are strongly heterogeneous.
decision.manuscript_use: none until variance/covariance and common exposure contracts are reconstructed for at least three independent systems
